blocks.prompt: 4 (i) Expand the following in ascending power of \(x\): \((2 + x - x^2)^4\).
blocks.explanation:
Bachon, is bracket mein teen terms hain (trinomial), jabke binomial theorem sirf do terms ke liye hai.
Hal yeh hai ke do terms ko jor kar ek bana do: \(2 + (x - x^2)\).
"Ascending power" ka matlab hai choti power se bari ki taraf likhna: pehle constant, phir \(x\), phir \(x^2\), aur aage.
Plan: \(y = x - x^2\) rakhein, \((2 + y)^4\) kholein, \(y^2, y^3, y^4\) ko \(x\) mein badlein, multiply kar ke like powers ikatthi karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((2 + x - x^2)^4\).
Humein find karna hai: \(x\) ki ascending powers mein expansion.
Tareeqa: \(2 + x - x^2 = 2 + y\), jahan \(y = x - x^2\). Is tarah trinomial binomial ban jata hai aur binomial theorem lag sakta hai.

\((2 + y)^4\) kholein
\[(2 + y)^4 = 2^4 + 4(2^3)y + 6(2^2)y^2\]
\[+ 4(2)y^3 + y^4\]
\[= 16 + 32y + 24y^2 + 8y^3 + y^4\]
Kyun: Binomial theorem ke coefficients 1, 4, 6, 4, 1. 2 ki power 4 se 0 tak ghatti hai: \(4 \cdot 8 = 32\), \(6 \cdot 4 = 24\), \(4 \cdot 2 = 8\).

\(y = x - x^2 = x(1 - x)\) ki powers
\[y^2 = x^2 - 2x^3 + x^4\]
\[y^3 = x^3 - 3x^4 + 3x^5 - x^6\]
\[y^4 = x^4 - 4x^5 + 6x^6\]
\[- 4x^7 + x^8\]
Kyun: \(y^m = x^m(1 - x)^m\), kyunke power har factor ko lagti hai. \((1 - x)^m\) ko coefficients 1, 2, 1 / 1, 3, 3, 1 / 1, 4, 6, 4, 1 aur baari baari signs se khola, phir \(x^m\) se multiply kiya, jo har power mein \(m\) jama kar deta hai.

Har \(y\) wali power ko us ke number se multiply karein
\[32y = 32x - 32x^2\]
\[24y^2 = 24x^2 - 48x^3 + 24x^4\]
\[8y^3 = 8x^3 - 24x^4 + 24x^5 - 8x^6\]
\[y^4 = x^4 - 4x^5 + 6x^6 - 4x^7 + x^8\]
Kyun: \(16 + 32y + 24y^2 + 8y^3 + y^4\) ke har term ko ab \(x\) ki powers mein likha. Har line alag rakhne se signs mein ghalti kam hoti hai.

\(x\) ki ek jaisi powers ikatthi karein
\[x^0: \; 16\]
\[x^1: \; 32\]
\[x^2: \; -32 + 24 = -8\]
\[x^3: \; -48 + 8 = -40\]
\[x^4: \; 24 - 24 + 1 = 1\]
\[x^5: \; 24 - 4 = 20\]
\[x^6: \; -8 + 6 = -2\]
\[x^7: \; -4, \quad x^8: \; 1\]
Kyun: Like terms (jin mein \(x\) ki power ek hi ho) jama hote hain. Power by power chalne se koi term chhoot nahi sakta.
Dhyan dein: \(x^4\) ke teen hisse hain (24, -24 aur 1); aksar students aakhri 1 bhool jate hain.

Ascending powers mein likhein
\[16 + 32x - 8x^2 - 40x^3 + x^4\]
\[+ 20x^5 - 2x^6 - 4x^7 + x^8\]
Kyun: Constant se shuru kar ke \(x^8\) tak; sab se bari power \(x^8\) hai kyunke \((x^2)^4 = x^8\).

Tasdeeq: \(x = 1\) aur \(x = -1\)
\[x = 1: \; (2 + 1 - 1)^4 = 16\]
\[16 + 32 - 8 - 40 + 1 + 20 - 2 - 4 + 1 = 16 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = -1: \; (2 - 1 - 1)^4 = 0\]
\[16 - 32 - 8 + 40 + 1 - 20 - 2 + 4 + 1 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x = 1\) se coefficients ka jama check hota hai, aur \(x = -1\) se signs bhi. Dono barabar aaye, to expansion sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) Expand the following in ascending power of \(x\): \((1 - x + x^2)^4\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi power 4 wala trinomial hai.
Ghaur karein: \(-x + x^2 = -(x - x^2)\). Yani wahi \(y = x - x^2\) yahan bhi kaam aayega, aur us ki powers hum part (i) mein nikal chuke hain.
Plan: \((1 - y)^4\) kholein, \(y\) ki powers daalein, like powers ikatthi karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((1 - x + x^2)^4\).
Humein find karna hai: \(x\) ki ascending powers mein expansion.
Tareeqa: \(1 - x + x^2 = 1 - (x - x^2) = 1 - y\), jahan \(y = x - x^2\). Minus bahar nikalne se andar dono signs badal jate hain, is liye \(-x + x^2\) ban gaya \(-(x - x^2)\).

\((1 - y)^4\) kholein
\[(1 - y)^4 = 1 - 4y + 6y^2 - 4y^3 + y^4\]
Kyun: Coefficients 1, 4, 6, 4, 1; 1 ki har power 1 hai, aur doosra term \(-y\) hai is liye signs baari baari badalte hain.

\(y = x - x^2 = x(1 - x)\) ki powers
\[y^2 = x^2 - 2x^3 + x^4\]
\[y^3 = x^3 - 3x^4 + 3x^5 - x^6\]
\[y^4 = x^4 - 4x^5 + 6x^6\]
\[- 4x^7 + x^8\]
Kyun: \(y^m = x^m(1 - x)^m\), kyunke power har factor ko lagti hai. \((1 - x)^m\) ko coefficients 1, 2, 1 / 1, 3, 3, 1 / 1, 4, 6, 4, 1 aur baari baari signs se khola, phir \(x^m\) se multiply kiya, jo har power mein \(m\) jama kar deta hai.

Har \(y\) wali power ko us ke number se multiply karein
\[-4y = -4x + 4x^2\]
\[6y^2 = 6x^2 - 12x^3 + 6x^4\]
\[-4y^3 = -4x^3 + 12x^4 - 12x^5 + 4x^6\]
\[y^4 = x^4 - 4x^5 + 6x^6 - 4x^7 + x^8\]
Kyun: Har term ko \(x\) ki powers mein likha.
Dhyan dein: minus ko minus se multiply karein to plus: \(-4 \times (-3x^4) = +12x^4\) aur \(-4 \times (-x^6) = +4x^6\). Yahin sab se zyada ghaltiyan hoti hain.

\(x\) ki ek jaisi powers ikatthi karein
\[x^0: \; 1, \quad x^1: \; -4\]
\[x^2: \; 4 + 6 = 10\]
\[x^3: \; -12 - 4 = -16\]
\[x^4: \; 6 + 12 + 1 = 19\]
\[x^5: \; -12 - 4 = -16\]
\[x^6: \; 4 + 6 = 10\]
\[x^7: \; -4, \quad x^8: \; 1\]
Kyun: Har power ke coefficients jama kiye, ek ek kar ke, taake koi chhoot na jaye.

Ascending powers mein likhein
\[1 - 4x + 10x^2 - 16x^3 + 19x^4\]
\[- 16x^5 + 10x^6 - 4x^7 + x^8\]
Kyun: Ghaur karein ke coefficients dono kinaron se ek jaise parhe jate hain (1, -4, 10, -16, 19, -16, 10, -4, 1). Yeh ittefaq nahi: \(x^8\left(1 - \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{x^2}\right)^4\) wahi bracket deta hai. Is symmetry se apna jawab check kar sakte hain.

Tasdeeq: \(x = 1\) aur \(x = -1\)
\[x = 1: \; (1 - 1 + 1)^4 = 1\]
\[1 - 4 + 10 - 16 + 19 - 16 + 10 - 4 + 1 = 1 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = -1: \; (1 + 1 + 1)^4 = 81\]
\[1 + 4 + 10 + 16 + 19 + 16 + 10 + 4 + 1 = 81 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono values asal bracket se milti hain, to coefficients aur signs dono sahi hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key "\(\ldots + 19x^4 - 16x^6 + 10x^6 \ldots\)" print karti hai, yani \(x^6\) do dafa. Chhata term \(-16x^5\) hai. Sahi expansion: \(1 - 4x + 10x^2 - 16x^3 + 19x^4 - 16x^5 + 10x^6 - 4x^7 + x^8\).
